_comment: Shared trait catalogue (docs/in_progress/PERSONALITY_PLAN.md §4.2). Each trait: category, roles (role -> draw weight, used for seeding in phase 2), label, prompt (a tendency, phrased 'tends to ...'), optional when (tags from newsroom/personas.py; empty = a standing tendency), conflicts. At most two traits per category per agent. Engine effects (phase 4) will be added per trait as an 'effects' object.
